snippet.title: Why PBR Matters
snippet.description:
Why PBR Matters

Series: CSYE 7270 Building Virtual Environments

Private draft for review. Narration: Liam, a synthetic voice.

CSYE 7270 EXAM REVIEW: CONCEPTUAL PBR PRIMER
Exam focus: PBR means physically based rendering. It describes how a surface responds to light, so materials behave consistently when the scene lighting changes instead of having highlights and shadows painted into the texture. Know what it is and why that matters.

Suggested viewing focus (approximately):
0:22 Definition of physically based rendering
0:34–1:19 Painted lighting versus a material responding to changing light

Beyond this exam: detailed PBR mechanics, texture-map settings and calculations, implementation exercises, and the PBR-based No-Bake system. Later technical sections are optional enrichment, not additional tested requirements. The full video is included for context, not because every detail is examinable.

Related course reading (broader than exam scope):
https://github.com/nikbearbrown/csye-7270-building-virtual-environments/blob/main/chapters/07-materials-and-textures.md
